steps.text: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C). Scrub and dry potatoes, then prick several times with a fork and place on a baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven until potatoes are easily pierced with a fork, 50 minutes to 1 hour. Remove from oven and cool slightly.
Reduce oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Cut a thin slice off the top of each potato; scoop out pulp and place in a small bowl. Beat potato flesh, butter, milk, and salt with an electric mixer in a large bowl until smooth and fluffy. Fold cream cheese and sour cream into potatoes; spoon mixture into potato shells. Sprinkle with paprika and place on a baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven until heated through and tops are golden brown, 20 to 25 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Creamy Twice-Baked Potatoes
raw_recipe.description: Baked potatoes are stuffed with a rich and creamy filling, then baked again for a delicious side dish the whole family will love!

video.description: Twice baked potatoes are a rich, creamy, and tasty addition to any meal! Cream cheese is the secret ingredient for this fluffy potato side dish!
video.name: How to Make Creamy Twice Baked Potatoes

review.reviewBody: My kids loved these but I did make some minor adjustments. I "baked" my potatoes in the microwave instead of the oven. Once scooped I sprayed the potato skins with cooking spray so they would crisp a little when later baking. I needed to add more milk than what was called for to get a creamy and fluffy consistency. I just added milk a little at a time until the consistency was correct. I also salted to taste.

This was a fantastic recipe for baked potatoes!! I had already used all my cream cheese to make cheesecake so I had to add more milk to make it creamy, about 1/2 cup total. Also for some extreme flavor I added 1 1/2 tbsp of minced garlic, 1 tbsp of parsley. I baked 4 potatoes so I can have really full potato skins, but I was still able to have enough remaining over to use as a side for next day dinner menu. Added some shredded sharp cheddar cheese, sour cream and scallions to the top with some steak gravy. Delicious!!

I believe these were the best twice baked potatoes I've ever had. I did modify them slightly by adding two cups of shredded cheddar (I made four potatoes though) and I used the entire thing of cream cheese (8oz) instead of the 6oz that it would be for doubling the recipe. I also know I used more than two Tbsp of milk, probably more like four. I then topped the potatoes with some shredded cheddar and baked. They were so amazing! We have tried so many twice baked potato recipes and this one is the winner!!!

This recipe was easy and delicious. I added fresh chives and finely chopped fresh broccoli into the blended mixture and twice baked the potatoes this way. This recipe was such a great way to have a potato side dish with just about any dinner.
Simple and delicious. I rubbed the skin down with olive oil and sea salt for a crispy shell.

Delicious. Added a tad more milk to help get a creamier texture. Topped them bacon bits and cheddar cheese before baking them the second time. Garnished with green onions/scallions prior to serving. They were a big hit and everyone loved them.

I made these substituting heavy cream for milk (I had some leftover that I needed to use) and Mascarpone cheese for cream cheeese (again, it's what I had on hand). Simple, easy to make, and absolutely delicious. I love that you don't need a lot of ingredients to make something to incredibly good.

These were SO good! I was licking the bowl and couldn't stop snacking on the filling. I baked 4 potatoes, took out the filling of all 4, but only used 2 potatoes to fill back up (so that the filling would be nice and thick, piled up high!) I also threw in a small handful of sharp cheddar cheese after mixing it together. Oh, I completely forgot to add the butter...it doesn't even need it! It's so rich from the cream cheese you won't miss it!
You could add additional toppings like bacon and sour cream if you want to go the extra mile, but again, it doesn't even need it! Tasty!

Happy to see a recipe that actually bakes the potato! Most steam it in the microwave or wrap in foil. 
I make twice baked often and add green onions or diced onion to the recipe. Awesome!!
These were very good and very simple to make. My only change was to use cream cheese with chive spread in place of the cream cheese and I used more milk until it reached my desired consistency.
These were not only easy to make, they had a wonderful flavor! I added minced bacon and a tsp of shredded cheddar right at the end of baking them. Great appearance and flavor!
EXCELLENT!!!!! My potatoes were very large so I slightly increased the sour cream and crem cheese. I cut the potatoes in half and each half was a nice serving size.
Great base recipe; easy to modify and very creamy!
I love stuffed potatoes and this one did not disappoint! The cream cheese made them creamy and rich! I will be making them again.

This was very good. So creamy and filling. Had to add more time to cook the potato. Seeing the other comments about using microwave would work as well. I never thought about adding cream cheese into mashed potatoes, but after eating this, I will for sure do it more often.
A different approach to twice baked potatoes. Since I only needed potatoes for two people this recipe was great. I did add shredded mild cheddar cheese.
Don't hesitate to make these. They are delicious!

I followed the recipe exactly except for using smaller potatoes than the large baking ones. These were creamy, with a rich flavor. I’ve made mashed potatoes before with butter, cream cheese, and sour cream added in. Putting the mixture back in the shell and sprinkling with paprika makes it a little fancier...company worthy.

The potatoes were good, but a bit on the bland side. Next time I would like to add some bacon and cheddar cheese on top. It seemed like potatoes stuffed with regular mashed potatoes. It is a perfect recipe for people that like their food bland.

These are fantastic! Easy and tasty! I used my stand mixer to mix everything together. I was pleasantly surprised that the only cheese in them was cream cheese. This is definitely a new favorite with my family! Thanks for an awesome recipe!
